Tokimaru Tanaka is a Japanese photographer based in Tokyo. After working in an advertising agency, he joined a photo production company. After three years of experience as an assistant, he started working as a freelance photographer. He specializes in portrait and fashion photography, and also has skills in reportage photography in interviews and travel.
